capabilities.label: Measured spatial cast removal
capabilities.name: Measured spatial cast removal
capabilities.mechanism: Fit two selected-only affine chroma surfaces and remove their spatial slopes while retaining the selected mean colour.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Measured radial illumination correction
capabilities.name: Measured radial illumination correction
capabilities.mechanism: Fit log-luminance against squared distance from an authored optical centre and remove the fitted radial variation.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Gaussian patch palette transport
capabilities.name: Gaussian patch palette transport
capabilities.mechanism: Compute the symmetric Gaussian optimal-transport map between two selected patch chroma covariances and means.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
capabilities.prerequisites: Required reference patches must contain selected pixels; otherwise exact identity.

capabilities.label: Three-anchor palette constraint
capabilities.name: Three-anchor palette constraint
capabilities.mechanism: Project chroma onto the closest point of the triangle defined by two selected patches and an explicit target colour.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
capabilities.prerequisites: Required reference patches must contain selected pixels; otherwise exact identity.

capabilities.label: Measured circular hue redistribution
capabilities.name: Measured circular hue redistribution
capabilities.mechanism: Compute a selected hue CDF with a seam in the least populated angular bin and redistribute hue into an authored angular span.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
capabilities.prerequisites: Target must have nonzero chroma to define hue; otherwise exact identity.

capabilities.label: Chroma marginal copula remapping
capabilities.name: Chroma marginal copula remapping
capabilities.mechanism: Map the two selected opponent-chroma marginal ranks through logistic quantiles while retaining luminance.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Hue-dependent colourfulness balance
capabilities.name: Hue-dependent colourfulness balance
capabilities.mechanism: Fit log colour radius to first circular harmonics and remove its measured dependence on hue.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Cluster-residual palette recolouring
capabilities.name: Cluster-residual palette recolouring
capabilities.mechanism: Fit three deterministic Lloyd clusters and translate each cluster toward authored anchors while retaining within-cluster residuals.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
capabilities.prerequisites: Required reference patches must contain selected pixels; otherwise exact identity.

capabilities.label: Measured channel-response reconstruction
capabilities.name: Measured channel-response reconstruction
capabilities.mechanism: Fit channel regressions from selected below-threshold pixels and estimate above-threshold channel values from the other channels.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
capabilities.prerequisites: At least6 selected below-threshold training pixels, and an above-threshold channel to reconstruct; otherwise identity is expected.

capabilities.label: Kubelka-Munk pigment mixing
capabilities.name: Kubelka-Munk pigment mixing
capabilities.mechanism: Interpolate reflectance-derived absorption-to-scattering ratios and invert the Kubelka-Munk relation; this is a creative reflectance approximation.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Variance-preserving principal monochrome
capabilities.name: Variance-preserving principal monochrome
capabilities.mechanism: Project selected RGB covariance onto its dominant eigenvector and normalize projected variance to measured luminance variance.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Two-patch discriminant monochrome
capabilities.name: Two-patch discriminant monochrome
capabilities.mechanism: Solve a regularized Fisher discriminant from two selected patch distributions to separate their colours in monochrome.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
capabilities.prerequisites: Required reference patches must contain selected pixels; otherwise exact identity.

capabilities.label: Isoluminant colour-edge lighting
capabilities.name: Isoluminant colour-edge lighting
capabilities.mechanism: Convert selected chroma differences unsupported by luminance contrast into a bounded luminance lift.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Selected error-diffusion tones
capabilities.name: Selected error-diffusion tones
capabilities.mechanism: Quantize linear luminance and redistribute quantization error to selected forward neighbours with Floyd-Steinberg weights.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Area-modulated photographic dots
capabilities.name: Area-modulated photographic dots
capabilities.mechanism: Render a spatial dot screen whose covered area follows photographed luminance, with antialiased dot boundaries.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Stop-domain luminance contours
capabilities.name: Stop-domain luminance contours
capabilities.mechanism: Render periodic contour bands on log-luminance isosurfaces, retaining the photographed colour direction.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Analytical exposure fusion
capabilities.name: Analytical exposure fusion
capabilities.mechanism: Fuse three bounded synthetic exposure renderings using their measured well-exposedness weights.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Constant-Lab-chroma lightness lift
capabilities.name: Constant-Lab-chroma lightness lift
capabilities.mechanism: Lift CIE Lab lightness with a bounded bell while keeping Lab a and b fixed, then return to linear Rec.2020.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Uniform-chromaticity cast translation
capabilities.name: Uniform-chromaticity cast translation
capabilities.mechanism: Translate CIE u-prime/v-prime chromaticity from the selected mean toward a target while retaining luminance.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
capabilities.prerequisites: Target must have positive luminance to define chromaticity; otherwise exact identity.

capabilities.label: Robust group-lasso chroma cleanup
capabilities.name: Robust group-lasso chroma cleanup
capabilities.mechanism: Estimate a selected robust chroma noise scale and apply the vector group-lasso proximal operator.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Geometric-median cast balance
capabilities.name: Geometric-median cast balance
capabilities.mechanism: Estimate the continuous weighted chroma geometric median with fixed-count Weiszfeld updates and remove that robust cast.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Compositional-geodesic colour tint
capabilities.name: Compositional-geodesic colour tint
capabilities.mechanism: Interpolate channel compositions along an Aitchison log-ratio geodesic toward a chosen target, retaining luminance.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Fixed-energy lightness redistribution
capabilities.name: Fixed-energy lightness redistribution
capabilities.mechanism: Solve an exponential-tilting KL projection toward a luminance anchor while preserving the total RGB channel energy.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

capabilities.label: Dichromatic reflection subtraction
capabilities.name: Dichromatic reflection subtraction
capabilities.mechanism: Fit a two-basis diffuse-plus-illuminant reflection model and subtract a bounded specular component.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
capabilities.prerequisites: Required reference patches must contain selected pixels; otherwise exact identity. Diffuse and target illuminant bases must be non-collinear.

capabilities.label: Mirrored palette hue folding
capabilities.name: Mirrored palette hue folding
capabilities.mechanism: Fold hue through a repeated angular reflection into a bounded palette sector while retaining chroma radius and luminance.
capabilities.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
capabilities.prerequisites: Target must have nonzero chroma to define hue; otherwise exact identity.

capabilities.label: Local cosine shrinkage
capabilities.name: Local cosine shrinkage
capabilities.mechanism: Soft-threshold a five-by-five discrete cosine transform and reconstruct its centre while retaining luminance ratios.
capabilities.distinctness: Cosine basis across a 5x5 patch differs from Haar block wavelets and scalar residual clipping.

capabilities.label: Biorthogonal lifting cleanup
capabilities.name: Biorthogonal lifting cleanup
capabilities.mechanism: Apply reversible CDF 5/3 predict-update lifting along both axes and shrink its detail coefficients.
capabilities.distinctness: Predict-update biorthogonal lifting differs from Haar coefficient thresholding and DCT analysis.

capabilities.label: Geometric colour median
capabilities.name: Geometric colour median
capabilities.mechanism: Use eight Weiszfeld iterations to minimize joint RGB distance; unlike a medoid, the result can lie between samples.
capabilities.distinctness: Continuous joint-distance minimizer differs from sample medoid and channelwise median estimators.

capabilities.label: Iterative colour mode
capabilities.name: Iterative colour mode
capabilities.mechanism: Move a Gaussian colour kernel five times toward the measured local colour-density mode.
capabilities.distinctness: Kernel centre moves over five density iterations; sigma/bilateral filters retain a fixed range centre.

capabilities.label: Pairwise robust colour location
capabilities.name: Pairwise robust colour location
capabilities.mechanism: Take the weighted median of all local Walsh pair averages rather than individual samples.
capabilities.distinctness: Walsh pair-average distribution is distinct from sample ranks, trimmed means and median-of-means.

capabilities.label: Geodesic colour averaging
capabilities.name: Geodesic colour averaging
capabilities.mechanism: Measure shortest four-connected contrast paths and average samples by their path cost.
capabilities.distinctness: Shortest contrast paths use connectivity, unlike straight spatial distance or recursive domain smoothing.

capabilities.label: Spatial patch low-rank repair
capabilities.name: Spatial patch low-rank repair
capabilities.mechanism: Measure covariance of overlapping nine-dimensional luminance patches and shrink its principal spatial mode.
capabilities.distinctness: Covariance is over nine spatial luminance dimensions rather than three RGB channels.

capabilities.label: Covariance-distance smoothing
capabilities.name: Covariance-distance smoothing
capabilities.mechanism: Use a regularized inverse RGB covariance to measure range weights before averaging colours.
capabilities.distinctness: Inverse covariance defines the range metric; earlier RGB covariance shrinkage reconstructs principal-component amplitudes.

capabilities.label: Multiplicative Lee restoration
capabilities.name: Multiplicative Lee restoration
capabilities.mechanism: Estimate multiplicative noise using local relative variance and a signal-dependent gain.
capabilities.distinctness: Signal-dependent multiplicative relative-noise variance differs from additive-noise Wiener estimation.

capabilities.label: Frost spatial damping
capabilities.name: Frost spatial damping
capabilities.mechanism: Use measured coefficient of variation to set exponential spatial damping for multiplicative-noise smoothing.
capabilities.distinctness: Variation-dependent exponential spatial damping differs from Lee gain and Gaussian range weighting.

capabilities.label: Gamma-MAP speckle restoration
capabilities.name: Gamma-MAP speckle restoration
capabilities.mechanism: Use homogeneous, Gamma-MAP texture, and strong-edge regimes derived from measured relative variance.
capabilities.distinctness: Three-regime Gamma posterior mode includes a quadratic texture solution rather than Lee linear gain.
capabilities.qualificationNote: The low-noise strong-edge regime intentionally returns the source; exercise the homogeneous/texture estimator on the qualification chart.

capabilities.label: Fourth-order surface repair
capabilities.name: Fourth-order surface repair
capabilities.mechanism: Solve the centre of a bounded biharmonic finite-difference stencil rather than a harmonic neighbour mean.
capabilities.distinctness: Fourth-order stencil includes signed diagonal and distance-two terms, unlike harmonic averaging.

capabilities.label: Fractional spatial detail
capabilities.name: Fractional spatial detail
capabilities.mechanism: Adjust a truncated fractional-Laplacian residual with power-law distance weights.
capabilities.distinctness: Truncated power-law nonlocal derivative differs from a difference of two box means.

capabilities.label: Parabolic background separation
capabilities.name: Parabolic background separation
capabilities.mechanism: Estimate a non-flat parabolic morphological opening and adjust detail above that background.
capabilities.distinctness: Non-flat quadratic structuring function differs from flat morphology or geodesic reconstruction.

capabilities.label: Oriented scratch repair
capabilities.name: Oriented scratch repair
capabilities.mechanism: Combine line opening and closing along an authored normal to reduce thin bright and dark scratches.
capabilities.distinctness: Line opening/closing is directional and separable from earlier isotropic top-hat cleanup.

capabilities.label: Quadrature phase detail
capabilities.name: Quadrature phase detail
capabilities.mechanism: Normalize a local even residual by truncated Riesz-like quadrature amplitude for bounded phase-sensitive detail.
capabilities.distinctness: Even/odd quadrature normalization differs from Hessian curvature or residual gain alone.

capabilities.label: Spectral surprise detail
capabilities.name: Spectral surprise detail
capabilities.mechanism: Remove local log-spectrum averages, reconstruct spectral-residual saliency, and use it to weight detail.
capabilities.distinctness: Log-spectrum residual saliency differs from an authored sinusoidal notch or spatial entropy.

capabilities.label: MAD impulse repair
capabilities.name: MAD impulse repair
capabilities.mechanism: Replace luminance outliers using a median absolute deviation test and an explicit minimum separation.
capabilities.distinctness: MAD scale tests differ from expanding-window extrema or ordinary median replacement.

capabilities.label: Circular hue smoothing
capabilities.name: Circular hue smoothing
capabilities.mechanism: Average chroma directions on the unit circle while retaining chroma magnitude and luminance where gamut permits.
capabilities.distinctness: Unit-direction averaging preserves chroma strength rather than filtering chroma coordinates.

capabilities.label: Chroma strength median
capabilities.name: Chroma strength median
capabilities.mechanism: Filter chroma magnitude by a weighted median while retaining the original hue direction and luminance.
capabilities.distinctness: Scalar chroma magnitude changes while hue direction stays fixed, unlike chroma coordinate medians.

capabilities.label: Local white-patch adaptation
capabilities.name: Local white-patch adaptation
capabilities.mechanism: Estimate channel illumination from local upper percentiles and adapt colour while retaining luminance.
capabilities.distinctness: Upper channel percentiles estimate a local illuminant; this is a colour adaptation heuristic.

capabilities.label: Local gray-edge adaptation
capabilities.name: Local gray-edge adaptation
capabilities.mechanism: Estimate channel illumination from local gradient energy and adapt colour while retaining luminance.
capabilities.distinctness: Derivative-energy illuminant estimation differs from intensity-percentile white-patch adaptation.

capabilities.label: Luminance skewness balance
capabilities.name: Luminance skewness balance
capabilities.mechanism: Use the measured third central moment to reduce local luminance asymmetry with a bounded correction.
capabilities.distinctness: Measured third central moment corrects asymmetry rather than variance or histogram rank.

capabilities.label: Tail-weighted detail
capabilities.name: Tail-weighted detail
capabilities.mechanism: Use the measured fourth central moment to adjust detail according to local tail weight.
capabilities.distinctness: Measured fourth central moment adjusts tail response rather than entropy or third-moment balance.

capabilities.label: Monotonic edge limiter
capabilities.name: Monotonic edge limiter
capabilities.mechanism: Reconstruct from slope-limited neighbouring intervals to suppress directional overshoot while retaining linear ramps.
capabilities.distinctness: Monotone slope-limited interval reconstruction differs from polynomial residual fits and shock evolution.

capabilities.name: Robust median deviation
capabilities.mechanism: Select source luminance distance from its patch median, normalized by median absolute deviation. Flat neighborhoods remain finite.

capabilities.name: Local binary-pattern transitions
capabilities.mechanism: Count circular bright/dark transitions around an eight-neighbor luminance binary pattern. Measures texture topology rather than brightness.

capabilities.name: Directional patch autocorrelation
capabilities.mechanism: Measure Pearson correlation between each source patch and a one-cell shifted copy along the angle direction. Flat patches map to neutral 0.5.

capabilities.name: Directional semivariance
capabilities.mechanism: Measure mean squared luminance differences across one-cell source pairs along the angle direction. This measures spatial roughness without patch-mean subtraction.

capabilities.name: Log-chromaticity sample distance
capabilities.mechanism: Compare log red/green and blue/green ratios to the sample. A one-code-value floor bounds near-black ratios.

capabilities.name: Gradient nonmaximum suppression
capabilities.mechanism: Retain source gradient magnitudes that are local maxima along their quantized gradient direction, producing thin edge coverage.

capabilities.name: Connected hysteresis edges
capabilities.mechanism: Keep weak gradient cells only when eight-connected to a strong gradient cell. Range supplies low and high gradient thresholds.

capabilities.name: Local Moran spatial association
capabilities.mechanism: Measure local standardized association between centre luminance and its four neighbors against patch statistics. Neutral or flat association maps to 0.5.

capabilities.name: Sampled patch correlation
capabilities.mechanism: Compare every source patch with the sampled luminance template using zero-mean normalized correlation. Radius is capped at four cells.

capabilities.name: Circular hue dispersion
capabilities.mechanism: Measure one minus the length of the chroma-weighted local hue resultant. Uniform hues are zero and opposing hues approach one.

capabilities.name: Colour prototype partition
capabilities.mechanism: Sample RGB prototypes at vertices and retain source cells closest to the selected prototype in RGB space. Ties use input order.

capabilities.name: Connectivity articulation cells
capabilities.mechanism: Use iterative Tarjan traversal to identify selected cells whose removal disconnects a four-connected region. Keeps original coverage at those critical cells.

capabilities.name: Selection graph core
capabilities.mechanism: Repeatedly peel selected cells below the required graph degree. Corner maps the required eight-neighbor graph degree from one to four.
capabilities.qualificationNote: Dense ellipse fixtures can already satisfy the chosen graph degree, so an unchanged output is valid. The known-answer test uses a square with a thin attachment and verifies peeling.

capabilities.name: Seeded coverage watershed
capabilities.mechanism: Flood from selected seeds with minimax inverse-coverage path cost. Keep the chosen basin; ties follow seed order. Each seed must lie inside selected coverage.

capabilities.name: Anisotropic coverage diffusion
capabilities.mechanism: Diffuse mask coverage with Perona-Malik gradient conductance. Tolerance controls boundary resistance and radius controls iteration count.

capabilities.name: Coverage curvature flow
capabilities.mechanism: Evolve coverage by level-set mean curvature with fixed frame values. Smooths curved interfaces while straight linear ramps remain stationary.

capabilities.name: Region maximum inscribed disk
capabilities.mechanism: Compute exact Euclidean distance to each component complement and retain its largest inscribed disk. Ties select the first maximum in raster order.

capabilities.name: Directional selected run width
capabilities.mechanism: Measure the complete horizontal or vertical selected run through each cell. Angle chooses the closer axis; range selects run length divided by radius.

capabilities.name: Thin-plate landmark deformation
capabilities.mechanism: Interleave source and destination landmarks. Solve regularized thin-plate radial basis functions to inverse-map coverage. Requires 3-8 noncollinear landmark pairs.

capabilities.name: Mean-value cage deformation
capabilities.mechanism: Interleave source and destination convex cage vertices. Mean-value coordinates interpolate source coverage continuously inside the destination cage. Outside coverage is retained.

capabilities.name: Triangulated cage deformation
capabilities.mechanism: Interleave source and destination convex cage vertices. A triangle fan maps destination barycentric coordinates to source triangles, preserving piecewise straight deformation.

capabilities.name: Conformal Mobius deformation
capabilities.mechanism: Inverse-map coverage with a complex fractional transformation inside elliptical bounds. Corner controls displacement and angle its direction; the ellipse boundary stays on itself.

capabilities.name: Path-normal coverage unwrap
capabilities.mechanism: Unwrap coverage along polyline arc length. Output X follows the path and Y samples its perpendicular strip with tolerance as half-width.

capabilities.name: Coverage-aware seam compression
capabilities.mechanism: Remove the requested number of minimum-coverage vertical seams with dynamic programming, then resample to the original frame width. Radius is capped by width minus one.

capabilities.name: Lissajous ribbon construction
capabilities.mechanism: Construct coverage around a closed sine-parametric path. Radius and radius plus one set crossing frequencies; angle sets phase and tolerance controls ribbon width.

capabilities.name: Log channel-ratio distribution
capabilities.mechanism: 10th,50th,90th percentiles of log red/green and blue/green ratios. Nonpositive channels use a 1e-6 floor; this is not a semantic skin estimate.

capabilities.name: White-patch chromaticity
capabilities.mechanism: Normalized per-channel95th-percentile nonnegative working RGB; a scene-dependent illuminant candidate, not a white-balance verdict.

capabilities.name: Gray-edge chromaticity
capabilities.mechanism: Normalized sixth-power mean of asinh channel derivatives over right/lower adjacency. Scene edges bias this independent illuminant candidate.

capabilities.name: Opponent colourfulness proxy
capabilities.mechanism: Opponent-plane spread plus0.3 times mean magnitude in signed asinh working RGB. Descriptive proxy, not calibrated display perception.

capabilities.name: Hue occupancy and largest gap
capabilities.mechanism: Fraction of36 opponent-hue bins occupied and longest circular empty sector. Near-neutral samples are excluded; no chromatic support reports zero coverage and full gap.

capabilities.name: Local hue discontinuity
capabilities.mechanism: Mean shortest angular change to valid right/lower neighbours divided by pi. Undefined neutral hues are excluded, not assigned an angle.

capabilities.name: Chroma-light mutual information
capabilities.mechanism: Discrete mutual information in bits between sixteen frame-relative asinh-luminance and opponent-chroma bins. Zero means independent bin populations.

capabilities.name: Regional colour dispersion
capabilities.mechanism: Square root of the sum of opponent covariance diagonal entries in each grid cell. Measures local colour spread without classifying skin.

capabilities.name: Robust luminance outliers
capabilities.mechanism: Fraction belowQ1-1.5IQR or aboveQ3+1.5IQR in asinh working luminance. A descriptive tail fence, not a defect or exposure judgment.

capabilities.name: Channel highlight dependence
capabilities.mechanism: Joint above95th-percentile support divided by the smaller marginal support, per channel pair. Ties at the percentile do not count as exceedances.

capabilities.name: Regional mean-variance fit
capabilities.mechanism: Least-squares regional variance versus mean in asinh luminance; texture also contributes, so this is not sensor noise calibration.

capabilities.name: Connected clipping support
capabilities.mechanism: Four-connected components with any working RGB channel at or outside0..1. Counts connected samples, not clipped source-sensor pixels.

capabilities.name: Clipping-weighted edge fraction
capabilities.mechanism: Fraction of right/lower absolute asinh-luminance edge energy touching an out-of-range or endpoint working RGB sample.

capabilities.name: Robust strip lighting profile
capabilities.mechanism: Median asinh luminance across eight vertical then eight horizontal strips. Median resists rare specular pixels; these are preview coordinates.

capabilities.name: Thumbnail phase sensitivity
capabilities.mechanism: Mean absolute difference between top-left decimation and2x2 box averages in complete blocks. Predicts phase sensitivity of a simple thumbnail, not camera or JPEG quality.

capabilities.name: Ordinal texture entropy
capabilities.mechanism: Normalized six-permutation entropy of horizontal triples; exact ties are reported separately. Asinh working luminance.

capabilities.name: Sequence sample entropy
capabilities.mechanism: Half-count-smoothed length-2 to length-3 template continuation on at most 384 evenly spaced samples; scene complexity, not a noise verdict.

capabilities.name: Quantized texture runs
capabilities.mechanism: Horizontal equal-bin run distribution after sixteen-level frame-relative luminance quantization; last bin includes runs of eight or more.

capabilities.name: Neighbour co-occurrence texture
capabilities.mechanism: Sixteen-level right/lower co-occurrence contrast, homogeneity, energy and natural-log entropy. Frame-relative asinh luminance.

capabilities.name: Bright mass lacunarity
capabilities.mechanism: Second moment divided by squared mean of above-median mass in complete 2,4,8,16-pixel boxes. Zero denotes no bright support.

capabilities.name: Regional corner response
capabilities.mechanism: Signed Harris determinant minus 0.04 times squared trace of the regional gradient tensor; positive corners and negative straight edges.

capabilities.name: Local illumination fit residual
capabilities.mechanism: RMS residual after a least-squares affine plane fit within each grid cell. Texture and nonplanar illumination both contribute.

capabilities.name: Line spectral flatness
capabilities.mechanism: Geometric/arithmetic non-DC Fourier-power ratio on up to eight 64-sample lines per direction. Uniform lines report zero.

capabilities.name: Neighbour Moran index
capabilities.mechanism: Population-centred luminance autocorrelation over right/lower grid adjacency, normalized by total frame variance; constant fields report zero.

capabilities.name: Robust local roughness
capabilities.mechanism: Median absolute asinh-luminance difference to right/lower neighbours in each grid cell; isolates typical variation from rare large edges.

colour.issue: Four creative local methods retained a full-frame RGB target plane and allocated per-pixel vectors/sets.
colour.change: Evaluate the same selected-only 7x7 stencil directly during final parallel blending using fixed-capacity stack scratch.

colour.issue: Luminance-only Wiener cleanup retained four unused chroma/covariance planes.
colour.change: Build chroma and cross-moment planes only for guided chroma.

colour.issue: An empty selection still built method statistics and local planes.
colour.change: Return exact identity before constructing any method context.

colour.issue: The new sequential diffusion path bypassed the generic finite-output fallback.
colour.change: Reject nonfinite candidate values and residuals before they can propagate; ordinary finite outputs retain the same formula.

colour.issue: New patch-based operations could use zero statistics from an empty selected reference patch.
colour.change: Explicit patch-validity checks return exact identity when a required selected reference patch is absent; the UI explains the prerequisite.

colour.issue: A black target has no u-prime/v-prime chromaticity, and a neutral target has no hue for angular palette operators.
colour.change: Return exact identity for those undefined target cases; ordinary valid targets retain the same mathematical operators.

colour.issue: Finite dot-cell sampling could leave dark gaps at nominal white.
colour.change: Explicit full-coverage white endpoint independent of the dot-cell phase; black remains exact black.

colour.issue: Sequential diffusion bypassed the generic nonnegative final-output safeguard for signed working-space samples.
colour.change: Apply the generic finite/nonnegative blend safeguard while preserving excluded samples exactly.

colour.issue: Returning an unchanged pixel from inside a transform still passed through the generic nonnegative clamp.
colour.change: Unavailable scientific-reference operations exit before per-pixel blending, preserving even signed source values bit-exactly.

spatial.problem: The fixed 256-edge nearest-cell grid could miss a 3x3 authored selection and sensor-scale features entirely.
spatial.change: 44 finite-footprint local methods (19 existing plus 25 new) now use immutable native-resolution stripes and 192-pixel tiles with four-pixel halos. Every original pixel remains addressable; selection coverage blends once.
spatial.memory: At most 2,097,152 RGB source cells (24 MiB) per stripe, a reused four-row source cache up to approximately 11 MiB, plus bounded tile/evaluator scratch. No full-resolution source clone.

selection.evidence: Choosing guided_smooth with radius9 then directional_ridge left Apply disabled even though radius is hidden and requestOptions sends default4.
selection.change: Apply the patch radius UI guard only when the chosen workflow actually exposes radius.
selection.regression: does not block a workflow because an unrelated hidden patch radius was previously excessive

selection.evidence: Existing experimental source radius validation happened after Frame::load in photographic::edit.
selection.change: Validate all photographic source radius limits, including template4, before preview loading.

limitations: 50 rendering methods,25 selections,25 read-only diagnostics; no recovered trained models.
Read validation results for measured functional coverage and residual limits.
